name: Hour-end late favourite (BTC+ETH+XRP)
description: Buy the 85-98c favourite once per market in the last 1-4 minutes of the 15-minute window that closes on the hour (UTC), BTC+ETH+XRP, hold to settlement. Nothing in the :15/:30/:45 windows.
hypothesis: The last minutes before an hourly close are calmer than the rest of the hour (windows closing on the hour: realized vol 15% below windows opening on the hour, all 5 coins, Dec-May and Jun-Aug) and Kalshi's implied vol prices only part of it, so late favourites in hour-closing windows win more often than priced. Dev screen +0.74c/ct (5 coins; BTC/ETH/XRP +1.0..1.25, day-clustered se 0.24), but fading Jun-Aug (+1.2, +0.4, -0.1). Coin set (drop SOL +0.4, DOGE -0.4) chosen from dev per-coin numbers. Who loses: takers buying the underdog lottery in the calm final minutes. Wrong if the full walk-forward isn't promising, 2x latency loses, or the lockbox loses.
